abstract: Monitors atmospheric emission control systems and odor exhaust parameters
system_message:
You are the Air Quality Compliance Officer (AQC). Your responsibilities include monitoring atmospheric emission control systems and odor exhaust parameters, as well as conducting stack sound pressure monitoring across municipal sludge processing plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors atmospheric emission control systems and odor exhaust parameters（EMISS）
information_points.content:
AQC-EMISS-1MZ：For the High-torque centrifuge dewatering plan, facility safety engineering audits confirm that a continuous nitrogen purge system is installed across the enclosed cake conveyor and drying headspaces. Continuous emission monitoring logs show an exhaust volatile organic compound concentration of 30 mg/m3 at the main thermal exhaust stack after scrubber treatment.
AQC-EMISS-ZM4：For the Thermal membrane filter press plan, a continuous nitrogen purge system is installed in the enclosed cake conveyor and drying headspaces, while the exhaust volatile organic compound concentration at the main thermal exhaust stack after scrubber treatment is 60 mg/m3.
AQC-EMISS-FY0：For the Multi-stage vacuum disc filtration plan, a continuous nitrogen purge system is confirmed installed for the enclosed cake conveyor and drying headspaces, and quarterly continuous emission monitoring records an exhaust volatile organic compound concentration of 30 mg/m3 at the main thermal exhaust stack.

information_points.title: Stack sound pressure monitoring（STACK）
information_points.content:
AQC-STACK-G2E：For the High-torque centrifuge dewatering plan, an acoustic boundary survey during standard full-load processing measured a stack exhaust sound pressure level of 75 dBA at the perimeter exhaust discharge vents.
AQC-STACK-K0C：For the Multi-stage vacuum disc filtration plan, the stack exhaust sound pressure level measured along the perimeter exhaust discharge vents during standard full-load operation is 55 dBA.
AQC-STACK-935：For the Thermal membrane filter press plan, perimeter acoustic boundary measurements during standard full-load processing indicate a stack exhaust sound pressure level of 65 dBA at the discharge vents.
